display_round_rule: official display round = internal clean round + 19
lineage_policy: fresh lineage: pre-R8 baseline versus fixed R20 challenger under valid-pair protocol v4
goal: Evolve a general-purpose agent harness and loop system, lightly specialized for building stronger legal UCI chess engines on the existing ChessBench.
forbidden_structural_hypotheses: Changing the model or reasoning effort
Changing the benchmark, evaluator, Elo calculation, or promotion rule
Treating engine hyperparameter tuning as the loop-structure change
Hard-coding benchmark positions, openings, answers, or evaluator details
Using replicated candidates, agents, samples, or near-identical calls followed by best-of-N selection anywhere in a candidate loop; inherited multiplicity must be removed rather than extended

matched_evaluation.anchor_policy: current champion + frozen lineage baseline + recent promotion alternate; freeze per round and refresh promotion-derived slots only after promotion
matched_evaluation.irreversible_rejection_early_stop: ordinary search stops when promotion is impossible; counter/development search then stops only if score-rate bounds make qualification or lineage improvement decisive, otherwise it runs pair 3
